findings.mechanism: Cursor-based access to m.tasks/m.jobs array without guaranteed bounds sync with table cursor state; if table cursor desynchronizes from data length (e.g. via resize/filter), array index out of range panic occurs.
findings.test: Trigger a table resize or filter change while cursor is active, then access the cursor index directly against the data slice.
findings.evidence: SOURCE: internal/tui/models/tasks.go lines 308-317 show cursor used to index m.tasks/m.jobs without explicit bounds check against the slice length in all code paths.

findings.mechanism: selectedSession() accesses m.sessions[idx] where idx=m.table.Cursor(). While there's a bounds check, m.sessions is modified by SessionsUpdateMsg without holding a lock during the cursor-read phase, creating a race condition on concurrent update.
findings.test: Run with -race flag while triggering SessionsUpdateMsg during cursor navigation.
findings.evidence: SOURCE: internal/tui/models/sessions.go line 897-901 shows cursor-based access to m.sessions without mutex protection during the read.

findings.mechanism: bubbles/table cursor not reset when rows are cleared/repopulated during view switches. A stale cursor position can exceed the new row count, causing panic on subsequent cursor-based access.
findings.test: Switch view modes rapidly in memory review table and observe cursor behavior.
findings.evidence: SOURCE: internal/tui/models/memory_review.go line 165 comment notes cursor clamping behavior; SetRows called without explicit Cursor(0) reset.

findings.mechanism: TUI has /dnd command (do-not-disturb toggle) but Flutter GUI slash command registry does not include /dnd. Users on GUI cannot access DND functionality.
findings.test: Open Flutter GUI and attempt to use /dnd command; it should be absent from autocomplete and produce 'unknown command' error.
findings.evidence: SOURCE: TUI command_handler.go line 269 lists /dnd; GUI slash_commands.dart _defaultCommands (lines 65-134) does not include /dnd.

findings.mechanism: TUI has /tasks command but Flutter GUI slash command registry does not include /tasks. GUI users cannot list tasks via slash command.
findings.test: Open Flutter GUI and attempt to use /tasks command; it should be absent from autocomplete.
findings.evidence: SOURCE: TUI command_handler.go line 274 lists /tasks; GUI slash_commands.dart does not include /tasks in _defaultCommands.

findings.mechanism: Service methods mutate shared sessions map. If any method fails to acquire the sync.RWMutex before read/write, concurrent access from RPC handlers and background processes causes data races.
findings.test: Run with -race flag while exercising session CRUD operations via RPC.
findings.evidence: SOURCE: internal/services/session_service.go uses sync.RWMutex but requires verification that ALL access paths acquire the lock.
